critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 521 lines - borderline, consider splitting routers (fleet, settings, agents, demo) into separate modules for Phase 2.
Global data_lock serializes all mutating endpoints; fine for Phase 1 but worth revisiting under concurrency.
GET /api/units/{unit_key}: if the find_one returns None, `Unit.from_mongo(None)` is called before the None check, which would raise before 404 is returned. Minor; add the None guard before parsing.
